pages.title: Inbox
pages.purpose: Single cross-conversation inbox in one order (UX plan 5.7): Waiting on you (AI Team gates and blocked agents, permissions, questions, forms, server requests, other servers' check-ins), then Running, then Finished (completion digests). Within a kind the request blocked longest comes first: AI Team rows by createdAt, the app's own requests in arrival order because they carry no time. Hosted as the Inbox root tab (embedded: true, no own Scaffold) or pushed with its own app bar.

elements.label: <what it was done to> / <what was done> · <when>
elements.effect: P6.2 While you were away: one automatic act (reconnect, request allowed by itself, queued message sent, heat pause/stop/resume) from controller.automaticActsHere, sorted newest first together with the finished rows below everything that waits. A tap opens the conversation it was done to (_openChat); server-wide acts have no page to open.
gates: act of the shown server or project, not acknowledged
onTap only when the act names a conversation

pages.title: {server name} · Work / Inbox / Project / Settings
pages.purpose: Main product shell for a connected server: app bar whose server name and status open the server switcher, current tab title, connection banner, and four retained root destinations, one per noun (Work, Inbox, Project, Settings), shown as a bottom glass dock (<760dp) or a NavigationRail (>=760dp).
gates: named route '/home' is ungated; via '/' requires conn.profile != null && conn.hasConnectedServer

cold start (HomeScreen.initialTab == null): opens on Inbox when conn.unifiedAttentionCount > 0 once the first read of pending permissions, questions and forms has settled, otherwise Work; decided once, and a tab the person picks first is final

elements.label: Dismiss
elements.effect: AppExitNoticeLine's KitNotice.onDismiss -> recovery.dismiss(): the notice folds away and does not return.

elements.label: Ctrl/Cmd+1 … 4
elements.effect: onAppShortcut(SelectDestinationIntent): _selectTab(_safeTab(index, conn.capabilities)); the index is the visible position (1 Work, 2 Inbox, 3 Project, 4 Settings).

elements.label: Work
elements.effect: _selectTab(_workTab): shows WorkspaceScreen(controller: conn) in the RetainedTabView. Rendered as NavigationBar destination (<760dp wide, keyboard closed) or NavigationRail destination (>=760dp, extended at >=1040dp).

elements.label: Project
elements.effect: _selectTab(_projectTab): shows ProjectHub(controller, focusSearchSignal: _findInFiles, backController: _projectBack). _safeTab falls back to Work when the server offers no project tool.
gates: ProjectHub.isAvailable(conn.capabilities): fileBrowsing || terminal || projectManagement (destination hidden and body replaced by SizedBox.shrink otherwise, e.g. Codex and Paseo)

elements.label: Settings
elements.effect: _selectTab(_settingsTab): shows the Settings hub, SettingsScreen(controller: conn, embedded: true).

elements.label: [system back]
elements.effect: _onRootPop: on Project, ProjectHubBackController.handleBack() first unwinds Files (keyboard, search, folder) and then returns to the hub; any other tab returns to Work; on Work a second Back within 2 s calls SystemNavigator.pop().

elements.label: Inbox
elements.effect: _selectTab(_inboxTab): shows ActivityScreen(controller: conn, embedded: true). The icon carries Badge key 'activity-pending-badge' with conn.unifiedAttentionCount (permissions, questions, forms, AI Team gates, other servers' pending counts) when > 0; no badge at zero.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Aborts the restore; composer and stash unchanged (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

elements.effect: Saves the current prompt with _conn.savePromptStash(current) (refused with a 'stash full' note at PromptShelfStore.capacity), replaces composer text, attachments and staged references with the selected entry, _persistDraft(), then _conn.removePromptStash(selected.id) unless a copy must be kept (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Aborts the restore; composer and stash unchanged (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

Browses from /root/projects up to /. A project (git repository, a project OpenCode knows, or any folder straight in /root/projects) opens with a tap; other folders are gone into. One primary opens the folder shown (never the home folder, / or the projects folder itself); New project makes a folder inside the folder shown (the app's Ubuntu: mkdir + git init; Termux: mkdir -p); Enter a path opens the path dialog. Remote servers, and Termux when it cannot run the app's commands, skip this sheet and go straight to the path dialog. Layout (2026-10-03, after Canva Move to a folder and the iOS Files picker): one header row (back chevron or Close, the folder name, a more menu with Show hidden folders and Enter a path), the place menu (This phone / Project space) as one quiet line under the title when both exist, one panel of folder rows, and a pinned bar with the text button New project and the primary Open <folder>. New project swaps the sheet content for a name step in place; back returns to the same folder.

'/' -> _Root (ServersScreen when conn.profile == null or the profile requiresPasswordReentry/requiresCodexTokenReentry; HomeScreen when conn.hasConnectedServer; else the root-connecting card)
